literal_meaning: জ্বলা (দহন বা উজ্জ্বলতা) এর দ্বিত্বশব্দ রূপে উজ্জ্বলভাবে দীপ্তিমান হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicative word indicating brightness and clear vividness
example_sentences_in_english: The stars are twinkling in the sky.
The gold jewelry is gleaming in the light.
note: This is an onomatopoeic reduplicative expression commonly used in Bengali literature to describe shining objects like stars.
